Summary: Home: hero with couple names date venue and CTAs
Description:
As a guest, I want to see David & Devon's names, wedding date (November 8 2027, 4:00 PM), venue (The Lucy by Cescaphe) and clear CTAs (RSVP / View Details) so I know I'm in the right place and what to do next.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Hero displays names, date, time, venue
- Two CTAs visible without scrolling on mobile
- Classic/elegant styling, mobile-first

Summary: Details: view ceremony time venue and schedule timeline
Description:
As a guest, I want to see ceremony time (4:00 PM), venue address (231 S Broad St, Philadelphia PA 19107), and timeline (4pm ceremony, 5pm cocktail hour, 6pm dinner, 8pm dancing) so I can plan my day.

Acceptance Criteria:
- All four timeline entries shown in order
- Venue address is tappable for directions
- Readable on 360px mobile screen

As a guest, I want to RSVP yes or no with my name and email/phone so the couple has an accurate headcount.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Required fields: full name, attending (yes/no)
- Email or phone required for confirmation
- Form validates before submit

As a guest with a plus-one, I want to add their name (optional) so they're included in the headcount.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Plus-one field optional, appears regardless of yes/no
- Name saved with primary RSVP

As a guest, I want to select a meal (Chicken / Fish / Steak / Vegetarian) so the caterer can prepare.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Four options shown as radio/select
- Required when attending=yes, hidden or optional when attending=no

As a guest with dietary needs, I want to note them as free text so I can eat safely.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Free-text field, optional
- Visible alongside meal choice

As a guest, I want to see a confirmation screen after submitting so I know my RSVP went through.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Confirmation shows name and summary of responses
- Fake backend is acceptable for prototype
- Option to go back home

As a guest, I want to browse FAQs (dress code, plus-ones, kids, parking/transport, gifts, contact) in an accordion so I don't have to text the couple.

Acceptance Criteria:
- At least 6 starter questions
- Accordion expands/collapses, keyboard navigable
- Mobile-friendly

Summary: Travel: view hotel block and directions
Description:
As an out-of-town guest, I want hotel block info (Cambria Hotel, code David&Devon, book by Oct 1 2027) and directions to the venue so I can book travel.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Hotel name, code, and deadline displayed
- Directions link to 231 S Broad St Philadelphia
- Parking/shuttle notes present

As a guest, I want to open the Crate & Barrel registry via a card link (opens in new tab) so I can buy a gift.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Registry card visible
- Link opens in new tab (URL TBD placeholder ok for prototype)
